description: Ministry of Sports - The National Associations of Sports Regulations No. 01 0f 2016
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973. It establishes legal and regulatory frameworks for the registration and constitution of National Associations of Sports, including procedural requirements, documentation, and compliance standards. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
